prompt: Create a narrative layout based on the theme (person, environment, object, date, phrase) following a 'Partial perception—White space pause—Full entry' structure. The first impression must be two soft image sets sandwiching a large white paper block, with a quiet editorial pause of black text in the middle. The upper part uses an asymmetrical three-grid collage: two close-up fragments on one side and a larger immersive detail on the other, using bold cropping to establish atmosphere through tactile fragments. The lower part features a wide main scene where the subject is seen from behind or in motion, maintaining a sense of accidental recording with ample environment and bokeh. The central white space provides breathing room: top-left has two levels of short sentences in restrained book font; bottom-right features an oversized freehand title with variable thickness, dry brush edges, and loose connections to create a gestural feel. Images are unified in natural sunlight with low-saturation green/cyan film tones, creamy whites, low contrast, and fine grain. Use light paper fiber textures and printing marks on the white background. Connect the photos and paper with narrow white lines to elevate the contrast between soft photography and decisive black handwriting.

promptZh: 根据主题（人物、环境、物体、日期、短语）创建一个叙事性排版，遵循“局部感知—留白停顿—全景切入”的结构。第一印象必须是两组柔和的图像夹着一块大面积的白纸，中间以黑色文字形成安静的编辑停顿。上半部分采用不对称的三格拼贴：一侧为两个特写片段，另一侧为较大的沉浸式细节，通过大胆的裁剪利用触感碎片建立氛围。下半部分展示宽广的主场景，主体以背影或动态呈现，保持一种偶然记录感，并留有充足的环境空间和焦外成像。中央的留白提供呼吸空间：左上角以克制的书体排布两行短句；右下角采用超大号的自由手写标题，线条粗细不一、带有干笔触边缘且笔画连接松散，营造出一种手势感。图像统一在自然光下，呈现低饱和度的青绿色胶片色调、奶油白、低对比度和细腻颗粒感。在白色背景上使用轻微的纸张纤维纹理和印刷痕迹。用细白线连接照片与纸张，以提升柔和摄影与果断黑色手写字之间的对比度。
